verdict.rationale: Formant's own materials describe a single operator view across entire fleets, with real-time telemetry, status updates, anomaly alerts, and per-robot current location and status. Fleet-level analytics dashboards can be filtered by device group or tag. The support rests mostly on marketing pages rather than detailed product docs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of a fleet-wide health/location map dashboard, explicit health-metric detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can monitor the health, location, and status of a whole robot fleet from one dashboard

citations.quote: Manage multiple fleets simultaneously from a single operator view
Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet. Configurable alerts and automated incident detection
Get instant visibility into every robot in your fleet.
One view across every vendor's fleet — AMRs, quadrupeds, humanoids, arms — without a separate dashboard
You can analyze from an individual device, or from a fleet of devices by device group or tag.
